title: Authorship and the Politics and Ethics of LLM Watermarks
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its primary findings concern the philosophical, political, and ethical ramifications of LLM watermarking schemes. It argues that private watermarks could give companies sweeping rights to determine authorship and that the dependence of watermarks on text entropy could lead to group-dependent detection rates, creating potential fairness risks. The mentions of the 'Bible' and 'Genesis' are used as linguistic examples of low-entropy text, not as a subject of religious analysis.
references: Aaronson, S. 2023. Watermarking of LLMs. Slides, Simons Institute, Berkeley, August 17, 2023.
